Method of Attack: Masquerading as a Gnome shell extension
Capturing audio recording from the user’s microphone
Use of self-extractable archive with autorun setup.sh
Encrypted communication with C2 servers using RC5 cipher
Storing stolen data locally if C2 communication fails
Attack Vector: Self-extractable archive created with makeself shell script
Autorun argument launching setup.sh to install malware as Gnome shell extension
Indicators of Compromise: Malware sample hashes (provided by Intezer Labs)
IP addresses and domains associated with C2 servers
Shared hosting provider with Gamaredon Group
Use of port 3436 for SSH connections to C2 servers
Domains with .space TTLD and ddns similar to Gamaredon naming patterns
